description: This source file contains unit tests for the AgentWorkspace component of the OpenClaw project. It verifies functionalities such as path display formatting, URL resolution, bootstrap file creation, safety checks, and behavior when certain files are present or absent.

methods.name: display path uses tilde for home
methods.description: Tests that the displayPath function correctly shows '~' for the home directory.

methods.name: resolve workspace URL expands tilde
methods.description: Tests that the resolveWorkspaceURL function correctly expands '~/tmp' to an absolute path.

methods.name: agents URL appends filename
methods.description: Verifies that the agentsURL method correctly appends the filename to the given workspace URL.

methods.name: bootstrap creates agents file when missing
methods.description: Checks that the bootstrap method creates necessary files and directories when they are missing.

methods.name: bootstrap safety rejects non empty folder without agents
methods.description: Ensures that bootstrapSafety method flags unsafe conditions when the workspace folder contains unrelated files.

methods.name: bootstrap safety allows existing agents file
methods.description: Confirms bootstrapSafety permits a workspace if the agents file already exists.

methods.name: bootstrap skips bootstrap file when workspace has content
methods.description: Verifies that bootstrap skips creating bootstrap file if the workspace already contains content.

methods.name: needs bootstrap false when identity already set
methods.description: Checks that the needsBootstrap function returns false if an identity file already exists with content.
